_description: One asset per class for the Gate 4a live run. The driver reads this file and probes `/looping/probe/browser_load [class, hint]` for each entry. A null value means that class is not available on this machine and skips to `n/a` in the result table. Hints are either absolute paths (User Library files) or bare names (Browser tree leaves) — the probe tries `load_item_at_path` first, then traverses by tail-of-path name match.
amxd: /Users/Shared/Music/Soundbanks/Ableton/Live Libraries/User Library/Max for Live Files/Audio Interface Detectors.amxd
